user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update task description with valid input
steps: Navigate to the task details page.
Click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
Enter a new valid description in the description field.
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully, and the new description is displayed on the task details page.

negative.title: Attempt to update task description with empty input
steps: Navigate to the task details page.
Click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the description cannot be empty, and the task description remains unchanged.

edge.title: Update task description with a very long input
steps: Navigate to the task details page.
Click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
Enter a long description exceeding the maximum length limit in the description field.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the description exceeds the maximum length, and the task description remains unchanged.
